pages.title: Hyperdimensional Boule
pages.text: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension. Its lattice continues past what I can see, so it holds more atoms than its volume suggests. Light entering it sometimes emerges from a different face than expected.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Lattice Growth Vat, I seeded a crystal with a Calabi-Yau Manifold and Exotic Matter. The growing lattice followed the manifold's extra dimensions and grew partly out of our space.
